summary:
Comprehensive implementation plan for HEALML Phase 2:
1. Project-Wise Dataset Separation and Management System with persistent Project models and strict tenant/project isolation.
2. Advanced Dataset Lifecycle Management with soft Archiving, Restore, and 2-step Permanent Deletion safeguards with typed confirmation phrases.
3. Client Workspace redesign with Top Navigation Project Switcher, Quick-Create Modal, and comprehensive Project & Dataset History tabs.
4. Immutable Model Training Runs & Versioning with side-by-side model comparison, configuration inspector, and evaluation reports.
5. Master Admin Full Model Operations Center accessible via a prominent button in the Admin Workstation with dedicated breadcrumb navigation, cross-client analytics, 12-stage pipeline tracking, and comparative accuracy leaderboards.
6. Enterprise Security and Audit Layer enforcing project/dataset/model access boundaries and logging sensitive administrator actions.
